resolve_instructions: Which of these descriptions fits this pull request best?

kind.instructions: What kind of change does this pull request mainly make?

docs_only.description: Only documentation, comments or other prose files change; no code, configuration or dependency manifest is touched.

ci_or_tooling.description: Only CI workflows, build scripts, linters or developer tooling change; no shipped source code is touched.

dependency_update.description: The change is to dependency manifests or lock files, with at most mechanical follow-up edits.

source_change.description: Shipped source code changes behaviour, structure or data.

dependency.instructions: What kind of dependency change is this?

patch_or_minor.description: Existing dependencies move to a newer patch or minor version only.

major.description: At least one existing dependency moves to a new major version.

new_dependency.description: At least one dependency is added that the project did not use before.

surface.instructions: Which part of the system does this source change touch most?

auth_or_secrets.description: Authentication, authorization, session handling, cryptography, or the handling of credentials and secrets.

data_model.description: Database schema, migrations, or the persisted shape of stored data.

public_api.description: A request or response shape, route, exported function or CLI flag that outside callers depend on.

internal_logic.description: Internal behaviour with no change to stored data shape, public interface, or authentication.

migration.instructions: Can the previous release keep running against the data after this change is applied?

compatible.description: Only additions: new tables, new nullable columns, new indexes. Nothing existing is removed, renamed or retyped.

breaking.description: Something existing is dropped, renamed, retyped, made non-nullable, or rewritten in place.

tests.instructions: Does the diff add or change automated tests that exercise the changed logic?

covered.description: Test files are added or changed and they exercise the changed behaviour.

not_covered.description: No test file is added or changed, or the test changes do not exercise the changed behaviour.
